title: Miami Perfume Making Experience - Fragrance Workshop 90 Minutes
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover a one-of-a-kind experience at Tijon, where creativity meets luxury! Unlike any other activity, our perfume-making workshop lets you step into the fascinating world of fragrance creation. You'll have access to over 300 unique oils to design your signature scent, making it truly personal and unforgettable.

Perfect for couples, families, or solo adventurers, this hands-on activity combines education, fun, and indulgence. Plus, you'll take home a custom-crafted perfume as a lasting keepsake of your visit. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply looking to try something extraordinary, this is an experience you won’t find anywhere else. Book now and create memories as unique as your scent!
